unified_law: Compiler deep-recursion walls are process-stack boundaries, not logic fuses. Graceful termination requires a software fuse tripping FIRST: tsc (depth 48 / fuel 999 / 5.03M) and -ftemplate-depth (gcc 900 / clang 1024) trip early; rustc's parser has no fuse so its stack wall IS the limit.
